mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5 percentage points within one month triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the unemployment rate crossing the 8.5% threshold, or the unemployment rate does not exceed 8.5% in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both economic demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS) creates a synergistic positive signal, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a baseline model that excludes the interaction between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS, or the proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion characterized by high supply growth (INDPRO) and suppressed inflation (CPIAUCSL) creates pressure on equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the late-cycle expansion regime, or the regime conditions are not met (INDPRO ≤ 94.8 or CPIAUCSL ≥ 3.0).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising interest rate expectations and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or the rate increase is not sustained for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 132,000 in one month signals robust labor demand, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline returns when PAYEMS crosses the 132,000 threshold, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700 in one month reflects strong demand for residential construction, stimulating economic activity and equity market gains, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain flat or negative despite HOUST exceeding 700, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) creates a strong labor market signal, reinforcing investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise despite the UNRATE-PAYEMS inverse relationship, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
